reviews.text: Amazing App. Outstanding photo repair results … my favorite!!!
Awesome App-Works Great!. I just tried this app and WOW! Night and day with the pictures. 4k old pictures. Definitely Recommend. You won’t regret it.
Awesome. I used for old or low light photos. Its works well. Very useful app for old photos.

AI Slop now, changes subjects. I’ve been using this app for years. I would upload a black and white photo and it would give me back the photo with vague color and skin tint. But it at least it gave me back the same people and subjects. Today I used it and it provided me better colorization BUT different people with different clothes and with features of AI slop like multiple hands, webbed hands, and weirdness. ABSOLUTELY WORTHLESS. Does not colorize your photo. It recreates a new image.

Great App. I’m impressed with this app. This is a very simple app to use. You just take your photo you upload it and it’s automatically colorized. I really like the way this app works. I wish other apps were as simple as this one was. This app is a must have for anyone that wants to convert black and white photos to color.

Poor Rendering. This app is only accurate in its rendering about 20 percent of the time. Often faces are changed enough to render the picture useless. Even worse it has added another head to a body where one does not exist. I have tried to improve a very faded color picture, but instead it changes the whole color scheme. Other apps do not do that. I have already turned off the automatic renewal. Anyone interested in a true rendering of an old picture, this app can’t do.
Not. Terrible correction. Caused an Afro American family to look Latino…nothing like family members.
Ai Adds Fingers. This used to be a good app. Now it’s Ai slop that changes the photos, adds fingers to everything with a hand, changes detail, … just run away.

Most extraordinary iOS app. The most extraordinary app for photography! There is no B&W to color conversion challenge I’ve thrown at it that it doesn’t flawlessly convert from the worst possible B&W to rich, beautiful almost Kodachrome-rich conversions. I wish the developed had a web page to which I could upload my conversions! If they did, I’d push this app on the top of the app-store list

Absolutely Beautiful. Fabulous restoration and color. You will treasure it!

Colorize Takes WAY Too Long To Load. I’ve been using this app for about 2 years now. However, for an application that is NOT FREE. & with technology in 2024, it’s becoming more frustrating to use it. Every single time it takes a minimum of 5 minutes to get from the main screen to the colorize screen. That is just too long. I’m going to have to report this issue to Apple and get my money back. I’d rather use an app that respects how important my time is. If the developers respected the customers time this issue would’ve been fixed. I’m quite positive I’m not the only one that has this issue.

Hidden Gem!!. I usually don’t write reviews but I decided to write about this amazing app which helped me adding colors to my grandparents’ black and white pictures. It seemed like traveling from past to present, amazing results especially the fine color tone. It actually doesn’t seem like transformed digitally but in reality. That’s the beauty of this app and I must say, it exceeded my expectations. 

Easy to use , especially user-friendly interface makes it incredibly easy to navigate, even for someone with minimal experience in photo editing.

Worth every single penny. Go for it. 🎯
